plan: Given my value is $3, I need to bid conservatively. The goal is to win only if the second-highest bid is very low. Bidding too high risks losing money, as my value is low. I will bid slightly above $0.1 to try and capture the item if the others undervalue it, but minimize losses if they bid higher. A bid of $0.5 offers a reasonable chance of winning cheaply.

Given my value is $24, I need to bid strategically to maximize profit. I'll aim to win only if the second-highest bid is significantly lower than my value. I'll consider the worst-case scenario: losing and paying nothing. To ensure a positive expected value, I'll bid slightly above what I believe the others might bid, but not too high. A bid of $14 should give me a good chance of winning against conservative bidders, while limiting my loss if I overpay.

Since this is a single-round auction, and I know my value is $11, I want to bid slightly above what I expect the others to bid, but not so high that I overpay significantly.
